item.title: About
item.description:
I am a Brazilian professional transitioning into the cybersecurity field, looking for my first professional opportunity. Currently, I am building a solid foundation in python, computer networks and offensive security through hands-on labs on Hack The Box.

My goal is to build a carrer specializing in Application Security (AppSec) and AI Security, fields that I find particularly interesting because of their direct connection to secure software development and the new risks posed by AI systems. At the same time, I aim to develop a broad foundation in cybersecurity by exploring topics such as networking, linux, cloud, cryptography and reverse engineering.
